posts.title: A first look at the Caltech Time Travel Gathering
posts.description: We recently ran an experiment inviting time travellers to California Institute of Technology. Caltech physicist Spiros Michalakis and emcee Ahmed Best welcomed guests to the Time Travel Gathering. Banner: Marcia Brown, after Stephen Hawking. Photo: Heather Nusz. Around 150 people were in attendance. Photo: Heather Nusz. In the lead up, I shared a bit of the backstory here. But some may be curious
